reason: I'm standing at my own chair all day and I count the drawer myself every night, so I already know who's in which chair and what the takings are. ₹999 every month plus ₹4,999 upfront is a lot to pay to watch a shop I'm already standing in, and WhatsApp does my bookings for free.
objection: This is made for a bigger salon with many stylists. For one or two chairs I'm paying monthly forever for stuff I don't need, and if your company shuts down or the app stops working, where does my customer list go?
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around ₹299 a month, with proof that my customer list is backed up and I can download it any time, even if the phone breaks or I stop paying.
